text:
Herriman had 3 scam reports in June, matching the prior month
C. M. Barnes
Herriman had three scam reports in June 2026, according to Better Business Bureau.
The city reported the same number as the previous month.
One report listed a $300 loss in a worthless problem-solving service scam, describing payment in advance for a tattoo session that was not provided after the appointment was canceled.
Debt collections was the most common scam type for the month, accounting for one report.
BBB Scam Tracker lets consumers search reported scams and share their experiences to help others spot similar schemes. The BBB says it reviews each report before publication and does not publicly display the reporter’s name or personal contact information.
Fraud reports have continued to register large financial losses nationwide. The Federal Trade Commission said consumers reported losing more than $12.5 billion to fraud in 2024, a 25% increase from the previous year.
| Date | Scam type | Reported loss |
|---|---|---|
| June 29 | Worthless Problem-solving Service | $300 |
| June 28 | Debt Collections | No reported loss |
| June 24 | Phishing | No reported loss |
